propositions: ChatGPT sessions may lack tracker worktree access, direct Gerrit access, or shell network access while retaining GitHub read-only connector; guidance must teach environment capability detection to recognize this state and define when native ticket creation becomes impossible (tracker-worktree-and-network/binary unavailable)

Fallback ticket payload must conform exactly to export.schema.json's required fields (schema_version, ticket_id, ticket_type, title, status) plus description and parent_id; ticket_id is an agent-generated UUID4 that becomes source_id on rebar import, enabling idempotent re-ingestion without duplication

The only sanctioned exceptional import path is `rebar import` consuming NDJSON (never raw event injection or GitHub Contents API writes); in dry-run mode, missing ticket_id/ticket_type records are silently skipped with no counter/warning, detectable only via would_create+skipped<total comparison

Guidance must prohibit hand-authoring, modifying, or deleting tracker event files, explain the append-only reason, require search-before-create when tracker is live, and mandate rebar validate/fsck after any exceptional import

Documentation test must verify AGENTS.md links to chatgpt-agent-guide.md, the guide does not recommend GitHub Issues as a tracker substitute, does not describe Contents API writes as sanctioned, names rebar import as the sole exceptional path, and fallback payload matches export.schema.json's required fields
